text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
……So, which are you betting on?
Is the card on the table higher than a 5, or lower?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah... as if.
Anyone with common sense could tell you. Obviously—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My! Nakayama-san, what sort of
game are you playing today?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, little lady.
You're not seriously thinking of sticking your nose into this match, are you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If one is to train one's mental fortitude for high-stakes moments,
entering the tiger's den is the finest way.
Please, let me join in as well!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... fine.
Alright, Satono. The rules are simple.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"With a '5' on the field,
all you have to do is guess if the next card is higher or lower...
So, which one are you betting on?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look, numbers below 5 are in the minority.
So isn't the answer obvious?

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
"It's LOW.
It's Low!
Low... is it?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
!! Heh, little lady.
Are you sure about that? Not taking the safe bet, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Because without taking risks from time to time, one cannot gain any returns.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Haha. You've got guts.
Come on, Sirius, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Wanna see this through until we settle it once and for all?
Just the three of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this moment, the card on the table was
a "4"...! Coincidentally, "LOW," which everyone had chosen,
was the correct answer...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And this lunch break would later be passed down
as the "Banquet of the Gamblers"...!
It was the beginning of a legend...!!
